description: Call before shipping anything that bundles third-party assets. Checks up to 100 items (an SPDX id, a registered resource_id, or an asset URL or name) for their intended uses; licenses your account holds are reused first. Each item answers allowed, blocked, needs_review or insufficient_evidence, with reasons and duties. Free, no key. Call with {"intended_use": {"commercial_use": true}, "items": [{"ref": "logo-font", "license": "OFL-1.1"}, {"ref": "hero-photo", "license": "CC-BY-NC-4.0"}]}.

intended_use.description: Uses to check: each true flag must be documented; omitted = false; unknown fields refused. For instance {"commercial_use":true}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK
